drivingQuestion: How may one place a vessel to receive sparks if that negates its preparedness?
outcomeNote: sparks have no substance, so no negation

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ וְהָא קָמְבַטֵּל כְּלִי מֵהֵיכָנוֹ! אָמַר רַב הוּנָא בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ: נִיצוֹצוֹת אֵין בָּהֶן מַמָּשׁ.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara asks: How is it permitted to position this vessel to receive the sparks, «doesn’t he» thereby «negate» the «vessel’s preparedness?» It is no longer prepared for any use on Shabbat as the sparks accord it set-aside status. The opinion that negating the preparedness of a vessel is prohibited has already been stated. «Rav Huna, son of Rav Yehoshua, said: Sparks have no substance.» They burn immediately and do not leave behind any trace of oil in the vessel. Therefore, the vessel remains suitable to be moved.
